The '''Scout 5''' was a model of [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] produced by [[Gandorthral Atmospherics/Legends|Gandorthral Atmospherics]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Its purpose was to protect the wearer from sun, wind or dust.<ref name="DC" />
